'''Bissillirus Blaster''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] assigned to [[Draenell's Point]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were each armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and two [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]], and carried a tripod-mounted [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]]. They participated in the defense of [[agricultural loading platform XT-21s]] during the [[Battle of Bissillirus]].
